budgets.toleranceDerivation: Same-head per-case differences: Tier A max 0.0033 (Linux) / 0.0004 (Windows); Tier B 0.0013 / 0.0012; Tier C 0.0060 / 0 (excluding search-analytics-inspecting@390x844, a two-mode arrival-order race reported, not budgeted); preparation 0.0027 / 0.0022.

navigation.definedBy: evidence: 0.0876 = search-filtered-unresolved@1920x1080 in two consecutive frames (0.0282 + 0.0585), identically on 961ff8eb (both samples) and db619129 (sample 1); the same viewport measures 0.0512 or 0.0637 when the two statements land in one frame. P1 measured 0.0637 there (0.0646 at 1366x768).
evidence: 0.0971 = search-filtered-unresolved@1024x768 (two-frame mode; 0.0901 in one), below P1 0.1513.
evidence: 0.2538 = search-filtered-unresolved@390x844 (one-frame mode; 0.2347 in two), below P1 0.2661.

evidence: 0.0605 = review-geometry-unavailable@1440x900 with its two movements in one frame (Linux, MAVI Quality Gate run 38202495528, 06e16ec8); 0.0450 when they land in consecutive frames (eleven samples). Below P1 (0.127-0.1295 at Tier A).
evidence: 0.1247 = review-geometry-unavailable@768x1024 (consecutive frames; every sample), below P1 0.3087.
evidence: 0.1205 = review-geometry-unavailable@430x932 (one movement; every sample), below P1 0.1476.
